Shadow Hearts   |                                           Asia Side Quests
     [W-1-10]      |
___ ___ ___ ___ ___|___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

[W-S-01] Yuri's Level 1 Fusions
         - Enough Soul Energy needs to be acquired to accumulate the rest of
           Yuri's level 1 Fusions. Luckily, we can revisit a dungeon that has
           all we need.


[W-S-02] Kowloon Fortress
         - What happened to Wugui? As long as you answered the prompts
           correctly as Alice in Kuihai Tower, you can go to Kowloon Fortress
           to find out. This is the ONLY time that you can do this quest!


[W-S-03] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight
         - Mr. Zhen has an array of monsters for Yuri to fight, with a very
           memorable prize for him when the Pit Fight is completed. You'll
           definitely want it. This is the LAST OPPORTUNITY to do this quest!
